verses.t: Notice, my lovely one, that I was courteous enough to say perhaps; that was very good of me.--But we are getting away from the subject. Put down your head. Hoity-toity! what is all this, my favorite sultana? and what means the sulky expression on your face? It is a pleasure to kiss a smile and not a pout.
How do you expect me to laugh? you say such harsh things to me!
